fields.summary_ko.0: AMD is expected to report Q3 2026 revenue of $13 billion (±$300 million), representing 41% YoY growth, while consensus expects $13.12 billion, implying 42% growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Increased demand for EPYC server processors and Instinct MI350 GPUs, along with expanded commercial notebook adoption of Ryzen AI PRO 400 series, are expected to drive Q3 results.
